summary: Elevate your career with ISO 28000 Lead Implementer certification. Our program provides the tools to implement effective security measures in your organization.
audienceIntro: This PECB ISO 28000 Lead Implementer course is ideal for professionals seeking to master the implementation and management of a Security Management System (SeMS) within their organization's supply chain. It is particularly beneficial for those responsible for safeguarding assets, ensuring operational continuity, and demonstrating compliance with international security standards. This course is designed for: Security Managers overseeing physical and digital supply chain security programs. Supply Chain Directors responsible for risk mitigation and resilience strategies. Logistics and Operations Managers implementing security controls across transport routes. Risk Management Professionals focused on identifying and treating supply chain vulnerabilities. Compliance Officers ensuring adherence to ISO 28000 and related security regulations. SeMS Implementation Team Members driving the establishment of security frameworks. Security Consultants advising organizations on ISO 28000 adoption and best practices. Management Representatives tasked with SeMS oversight and performance reporting. IT Security Specialists integrating cybersecurity into supply chain operations. Business Continuity Planners developing resilience strategies for supply chain disruptions.
modules: Introduction to ISO 28000 and SeMS Initiation
SeMS Performance, Improvement, and Audit Readiness
prerequisites: To fully benefit from this training course, you should have a basic knowledge of ISO 28000 requirements. Additionally, a general understanding of security management principles and concepts will facilitate the learning process.
